claim_label: Defining student success as independent mastery versus AI collaboration
description: This conflict centers on the appropriate metrics for evaluating academic achievement. It contrasts measuring a student's ability to solve problems entirely unassisted against evaluating their skill in collaboratively directing AI to solve complex tasks.

instances.assertion: Success must be measured by a student's ability to solve problems and explain concepts completely unassisted by AI.
Success should be measured by how well a student can direct an AI to solve complex problems collaboratively.
